The files created in January and April of this year correspond to Athens and Seoul, respectively, while the others are from Paris. from datetime import datetime

# Login to file_system
file_pw = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]['password']
access_token = apis.file_system.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=file_pw)['access_token']

base_dir = '~/photographs/vacations/'

# Get current root files
root_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=base_dir, recursive=False, entry_type='files')
if not root_files:
    root_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=base_dir, recursive=False, entry_type='all')

cur_year = datetime.now().year

# Build classifications based on created_at month/year
meta = []
for p in root_files:
    info = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=p, access_token=access_token)
    created_at = info.get('created_at')
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at.replace('Z','+00:00')) if isinstance(created_at, str) else created_at
    meta.append({
        'src_path': p,
        'filename': p.split('/')[-1],
        'created_at': created_at,
        'created_year': dt.year,
        'created_month': dt.month,
    })

athens = [f for f in meta if f['created_year']==cur_year and f['created_month']==1]
seoul = [f for f in meta if f['created_year']==cur_year and f['created_month']==4]
paris = [f for f in meta if f not in athens and f not in seoul]

print('current_year', cur_year)
print('counts', {'Athens': len(athens), 'Seoul': len(seoul), 'Paris': len(paris)})

# Ensure destination directories exist
for folder in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    apis.file_system.create_directory(
        directory_path=base_dir + folder,
        access_token=access_token,
        recursive=True,
        allow_if_exists=True
    )

# Move files, preserving original file names
folder_to_items = {'Athens': athens, 'Seoul': seoul, 'Paris': paris}
move_results = []
for folder, items in folder_to_items.items():
    for it in items:
        dest_dir = base_dir + folder
        src = it['src_path']
        dest = dest_dir + '/' + it['filename']
        resp = apis.file_system.move_file(
            source_file_path=src,
            destination_file_path=dest,
            access_token=access_token,
            overwrite=False,
            retain_dates=True
        )
        move_results.append({'folder': folder, 'src': src, 'dest': dest, 'message': resp.get('message')})

print('moved_count', len(move_results))
print('moved_by_folder', {k: sum(1 for r in move_results if r['folder']==k) for k in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']})
print('sample_moves', move_results[:5])

# Post-move verification: root should be empty or contain only non-files; list subdirs
for folder in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    d = base_dir + folder
    sub_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=d, recursive=False, entry_type='files')
    if not sub_files:
        sub_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=d, recursive=False, entry_type='all')
    print('subdir_count', folder, len(sub_files))

root_files_after = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=base_dir, recursive=False, entry_type='all')
print('root_entries_after_move', len(root_files_after))
print('root_entries_after_sample', root_files_after[:10])
